⌈If the configuration parameter DemDebounceCounterStorage is set to True, the Dem module shall store the current value of the internal debounce counter non-volatile (refer to [SWS_Dem_00341]).⌋ Note: DemDebounceCounterStorage is not supported for time based debouncing.
[SWS_Dem_00675] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04124
⌈If the configuration parameter DemDebounceCounterStorage is set to True, the Dem module shall re-store the current value of the internal debounce counter during each startup (latest in Dem_Init).⌋ Note: BSW events using non-volatile storage of the internal debounce counter cannot be reported before Dem_Init, because the value needs first to be restored.
